description: This bar chart, from the paper "Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation," illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems—NatSQL (represented by light blue bars) and a second system (represented by dark blue bars)—across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis, labeled "Execution Accuracy," is scaled linearly from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four categories in order from left to right. For each category, two bars are grouped side-by-side: the NatSQL bar is light blue and the other system's bar is dark blue. The chart displays the following values: for the Simple category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21 and the other system has 63.14; for Moderate, NatSQL has 39.64 and the other system has 48.60; for Challenging, NatSQL has 32.32 and the other system has 36.11; and for Total, NatSQL has 51.35 and the other system has 56.19. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories listed on the x-axis. The legend in the top right corner identifies the light blue bar as NatSQL and the dark blue bar as the other system, though the second system's name is not explicitly labeled in the legend.
